plan.objective: Squared per-player two-minute-bin occupancy error + v49 pair weight .25 times squared whole-game pair overlap error + existing minimumStint/600 per substitution + short-stint shortfall in minutes. All weights fixed before first simulation. Exact five per slot, rounded per-player slots sum480, official starters at first slot. Deterministic quota-preserving rectangle swaps; game RNG unchanged.
plan.scope: Known game minute reconstruction; source profiles exclude entire game fold. No target-game stint sequence, scoring outcome, or player-name overrides. Joint feasibility guarantees apply to the planned grid, not real dead-ball execution or foul-outs.

Confirm once on disjoint120games/season with same gate; if fail, reject without further tuning on confirmation. Full4season3seed evaluation only after confirmation.
